title: Bottle Past Drinking Window
dataSources: CellarTracker bottles (`cellartracker:bottle`), Vivino wines (`vivino:wine`), spirits bottles (`spirit:bottle`), and wine tasting notes (`wine:tasting`).
app: CellarTracker bottle exports, Vivino wine scans, spirits inventory logs, and tasting note journals forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cellartracker:bottle vintage_year=* drink_by_year=* bottle_status="cellared"
| eval years_past=2026-drink_by_year
| where years_past>0
| sort - years_past
| table wine_name region vintage_year drink_by_year years_past
description: Lists cellared bottles whose recommended drink-by year has passed.
value: Overholding past peak risks cork failure and wasted investment on wines past their best window.
implementation: Include `drink_by_year` on CellarTracker exports and review overdue bottles each quarter.
visualization: Table of past-window bottles sorted by years overdue.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks wines in your cellar that probably should have been opened already.
